import sys

def average(n, v):
    total = sum(v)
    return total // n

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    v = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))
    print(average(n, v))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
